messages.author: 53e34592fe12f8a1
messages.subject: Growth cuve analysis: time (in)variant predictors
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to replicate a paper from Hox & Stoel 2005, in which they tested a growth curve model with time variant and invariant predictors.
I get quite a different Chi2 (almost twice as large) and RMSEA. Also, I noticed when plotting my model, that the growth() function automaticaly adds covariances
between the invariant predictor (z) and the time-variant predictors (x0-3).Also, covariances between x0-3 are added automatically whilst these are not latent variables.
I thought this was quite strange and tried to remove this by setting: auto.cov.y = FALSE,
but this doesn't change anything (I think true is the default in growth() and this cannot be changed?).

Anyone knows where these covariances come from?

My model code is quite standard:

#Model 3 with time variant and invariant regressors
GCMmodel3 <- '
#Slope and Intercept
B0 =~ 1*Y0 + 1*Y1 + 1*Y2 + 1*Y3
B1 =~ 0*Y0 + 1*Y1 + 2*Y2 + 3*Y3

# #Equal variances of error (homoskedasticity)
Y0~~ label("Ve")*Y0
Y1~~ equal("Ve")*Y1
Y2~~ equal("Ve")*Y2
Y3~~ equal("Ve")*Y3

# time-varying covariates (equalized as in Stoel et al., 2004)
Y0 ~ TVC*X0
Y1 ~ TVC*X1
Y2 ~ TVC*X2
Y3 ~ TVC*X3

# time-invariant covariate
B0 ~ Z
B1 ~ Z
'
Hopefully, anyone knows why these covariances (mmainly between z and x0-4) keep popping up!
Many thanks!!
Carolien

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Growth cuve analysis: time (in)variant predictors
parts:
If you use the lavaan() function, nothing will be estimated by default except the parameters you specify in the model syntax.  I would recommend that.  The growth() function's defaults are only set up for simple growth curve models without covariates, common factors, etc.  The covariances among exogenous predictors should be estimated, though (or just assumed fixed, using fixed.x = TRUE)

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
